description: `pardner open --http-port 9000` (and `client open --http-port 9000`) on an already-running client succeeds silently and keeps the old port.
expected: A warning such as "Pardner is already running on 52178; --http-port takes effect after pardner client stop", or a non-success result.
suggested_fix: In ensureRunning, when the probe is `running` and --http-port differs from the running port, include a `warning` field (or fail with a PORT_MISMATCH code).

description: Opening the client at http://localhost:PORT/pardner/ (instead of 127.0.0.1) shows raw JSON in the browser.
expected: A short HTML page naming the configured address, e.g. "Open Pardner at http://127.0.0.1:52178/pardner/" with a link.
actual: {"code":"ORIGIN_REJECTED","error":"Open the configured client address"} as a 403 JSON document; the address is not named.
suggested_fix: For HTML navigations (Accept: text/html) to /pardner/ with a rejected Host, return a minimal HTML page with the configured URL; include the URL in the JSON error too.

criterion: Scroll necessity: no unnecessary scrolling for primary task
description: At 390x844 the header wraps to three rows and the three filter selects stack full width, pushing the first task card to ~490px.
expected: Tasks visible in the first half of a phone-width viewport; filters collapsed behind one control.
actual: Header + tabs + three stacked filters occupy the top ~490px.
suggested_fix: Collapse the filter row behind a single Filters button below a breakpoint.

description: With no --harness/--name flags, the client registers a default setup agent (client status shows setupAgent {harnessId:"openai-codex", name:"Setup agent"}); it appears on the board as avatar "SA" and filter option "Setup agent · agent", and the Welcome copy says "Setup agent (Codex) is registered as your agent" even if no Codex agent set anything up.
expected: No setup agent unless one was named, or the default is explained and easy to rename/remove.
actual: A generic "Setup agent" Codex Actor is present on every project.
suggested_fix: Omit the setup-agent Actor when no setup agent metadata was given, or label it with its origin.
